items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I don't remember George at all.

ctx.x: Well, what I could say, I liked Pills. He was a pretty good clarinet player. I liked Pills very well. Now Jim was a good clarinet player. Jimbo, you understand? But Jimbo had a whole lot of chicken in him. Yeah. He was ready to run in to see somebody got noise, he couldn't fly. He'd done a couple of times, I'd run him off the truck just by going around him. Just by going there and looking at him playing. Got off the truck, got a man, take a walk. And they saw him home, took one day, went home, got my clarinet,…
Georgey Boy. Oh, Georgey Boy. There's so many George's. How about George Lewis in those days? Do you remember him?

Well George, George was alright. George Lewis was alright. But I didn't know George in, let's see. I was up in there in that time doing Jimbo. Doing Jimbo and Zep and them. I don't remember George at all.
